mapper.sql: id, name, sub_pattern, obj_pattern, act_pattern, condition_expr, effect, priority, enabled, note, operator, create_time, update_time
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO mcp_policy_definition (name, sub_pattern, obj_pattern, act_pattern, condition_expr, effect, priority, enabled, note, operator, update_time) VALUES (#{name}, #{subPattern}, #{objPattern}, #{actPattern}, #{conditionExpr}, #{effect}, #{priority}, #{enabled}, #{note}, #{operator}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
mapper.update: UPDATE mcp_policy_definition SET name = #{name}, sub_pattern = #{subPattern}, obj_pattern = #{objPattern}, act_pattern = #{actPattern}, condition_expr = #{conditionExpr}, effect = #{effect}, priority = #{priority}, enabled = #{enabled}, note = #{note}, operator = #{operator}, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT FROM mcp_policy_definition ORDER BY priority DESC, id
